text:
Once upon a time, there was a popular cat named Kitty. Kitty loved to play with the laundry. One day, Kitty saw the laundry disappear. Kitty was sad.
Kitty asked her friend, Doggy, "Did you see the laundry disappear?" Doggy said, "Yes, I did. Let's find it together." So, Kitty and Doggy went to look for the laundry.
They found the laundry under a big tree. Kitty and Doggy were happy. They played with the laundry all day. From that day on, Kitty and Doggy became best friends.

Once upon a time, there was a cheerful flea named Fifi. Fifi lived on a big dog named Barky. Barky and Fifi were very good friends.
One day, Fifi had a question for Barky. "Barky," Fifi asked, "why do you like to run so much?" Barky smiled and said, "I like to run because it makes me happy and I feel free."
Fifi thought about Barky's words and decided to try running too. She jumped off Barky and ran on the soft grass. Fifi found that running made her happy as well. From that day on, Fifi and Barky would run and play together, always with big smiles on their faces.

Once upon a time, there was a little cat named Mittens. Mittens had soft, velvet fur that felt nice to pet. One day, Mittens was walking outside when she saw a big bird in the sky. The bird swooped down and tried to strike Mittens with its sharp claws. Mittens got nervous and ran away as fast as she could. From that day on, Mittens always kept an eye out for big birds in the sky.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to read books and learn new things. One day, she decided to create her own library in her room. She gathered all her favorite books and put them on a shelf. 
Her little brother Jack was jealous because he wanted to read the books too. Lily decided to share her books with Jack and they both read together. They had so much fun reading and learning new things. 
From that day on, Lily's room became a magical library where she and Jack could read and learn together. They were both happy and no longer jealous of each other. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. He loved going to the beach with his mom and dad. One day, they went to the shore and played in the sand. Timmy built a big castle with a moat around it.
As they were playing, Timmy's mom saw a little girl crying. She went over to her and asked what was wrong. The little girl said she lost her teddy bear. Timmy's mom was very compassionate and told her they would help her find it.
Timmy and his parents searched all over the beach for the teddy bear. Finally, Timmy remembered that they saw a teddy bear near the rocks. They went over to the rocks and found the teddy bear. The little girl was so happy and thanked them. Timmy felt proud that he helped someone in need.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to talk and speak to everyone she met. One Wednesday, she went to the park and met a persistent little puppy. The puppy wanted to play with her all day long, but Lily had to go home for dinner. 
The next Wednesday, Lily went back to the park hoping to see her new friend again. And there he was, waiting for her with a wagging tail. They played together all afternoon, and the persistent puppy never left her side. 
Lily was so happy to have a new friend to speak with every Wednesday. She loved the way the puppy would listen to her stories and bark in excitement. From that day on, Lily and the puppy would meet at the park every Wednesday to play and speak together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. She liked to play outside in the sun. One day, she saw a pretty leaf on the ground. The leaf was red and yellow. Amy picked up the leaf and wanted to save it.
Amy showed the leaf to her friend, Max. Max was deaf, so he could not hear Amy when she talked. But Max could see the pretty leaf. Max said, "Wow! That leaf is very pretty!" They both smiled and looked at the leaf.
Amy and Max decided to save the leaf in a special box. They put the leaf in the box and closed it. Every day, they would open the box and look at the pretty leaf. They were happy they could save the leaf together.

One day, a boy named Tim found a small box. The box had a note on top. The note said, "Open me!" Tim was excited. He wanted to see what was inside the box.
Tim tried to open the box, but it was hard. He asked his mom for help. "Mom, can you help me open this box?" he said. His mom tried to open it, but it would not open. She said, "This is not a regular box, Tim. We need a key to open it."
Tim looked around his room for a key that would fit. He found a small key under his bed. He tried the key, and it fit! The box opened, and inside was a toy car. Tim was very happy. He played with the toy car all day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to run and play outside in the park. One day, she was running so fast that she slipped and fell on the ground. 
Her mom came over and asked, "Are you okay, Lily?" 
Lily replied, "Yes, Mommy. I just slipped a little." 
As they were walking home, they saw some smoke coming from a nearby house. Lily's mom called the fire department and they rushed over to put out the fire. 
After the fire was out, Lily's mom said, "Thank goodness the fire was put out quickly. The smoke could have been very dangerous." 
Lily looked up at the sky and saw the sun setting. She said, "Look, Mommy! The sky is so light and pretty." 
Her mom smiled and said, "Yes, it is. Let's go home and make some dinner."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. Mia had a toy cat that she loved a lot. She would hug her cat every day and take it with her everywhere she went. Mia was a stubborn girl and would not let anyone else play with her cat.
One day, Mia found a nail on the ground. She thought it was shiny and pretty, so she picked it up to show her mom. Mia's mom told her to be careful with the nail because it was sharp.
Mia was still stubborn and wanted to keep the nail. She put it in her pocket and went to play outside. While playing, the nail fell out of her pocket and Mia didn't notice. Later, when she went back inside, she saw her cat lying on the floor. Mia picked up her cat and gave it a big hug. She was happy to have her cat and forgot all about the nail.

One day, a little girl named Amy was playing with her toys. She saw her mom being thoughtful and sad. Amy wanted to give her mom a big hug to make her feel better. She walked up to her mom and said, "Mom, I give you a hug."
Her mom smiled and said, "Thank you, Amy. You are very thoughtful." Amy felt happy that she made her mom smile. Then, she went back to playing with her toys.
Suddenly, Amy's toy bear started to talk! The bear said, "Amy, I can give you one wish." Amy was very surprised. She thought for a moment and said, "I wish for a big cake!" The bear clapped its paws, and a big cake appeared on the table. Amy and her mom laughed and ate the cake together. And from that day on, Amy always remembered to be thoughtful and give hugs to her mom.

Once upon a time, there was a sheep named Baa. Baa had very soft wool that was perfect for making warm blankets. But Baa was restless and didn't like to stay in one place for too long. One day, Baa wandered too far from the farm and got lost. 
Baa was very scared and didn't know what to do. Suddenly, a kind farmer found Baa and brought her back to the farm. The farmer noticed that Baa's wool was all tangled and messy. So, the farmer decided to reverse the wool and make it soft and smooth again. 
Baa was very happy to be back on the farm and have her wool taken care of. From that day on, Baa learned to stay close to her friends and not wander too far away. And the farmer made sure to keep Baa's wool looking beautiful so that it could be used to make warm blankets for everyone to snuggle up in.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird named Tweety who lived in a big tree. Tweety loved to fly high in the sky and explore new places. One day, Tweety flew too far and got lost. She didn't know where she was and she felt scared.
Suddenly, she saw a big, heavy rock on the ground. She decided to land on it and rest for a while. While she was sitting on the rock, a wise old owl flew by and asked, "Why are you sitting on that heavy rock, little bird?"
Tweety replied, "I got lost and I'm scared. I don't know how to get back home." The owl smiled and said, "Don't be scared, little bird. Just fly in any direction and you will eventually find your way home."
Tweety thanked the owl and flew away. She realized that sometimes we get scared and feel heavy, but we just need to keep moving forward and we will eventually find our way.

Once upon a time, there lived a little boy and his pet dog, Rex. 
One day, the little boy had an idea. He said to Rex, “Let’s mail a letter to the ceiling!” Rex barked excitedly and they got to work. 
They wrote a letter, put a stamp on it and put it in the mailbox. The little boy knew the letter would go to the ceiling and wondered what his letter would come back.
 
The next morning the little boy and Rex ran outside to check the mailbox. He was excited to see the letter had come back. Inside the envelope was something cold. The little boy opened the envelope and found a snowflake inside! 
The little boy and Rex were so excited and ran around the garden, catching and throwing snowflakes like they were having a snow fight. 
The little boy and Rex had so much fun playing in the snow and they never forgot the magical day they mailed a letter to the ceiling!

Once upon a time, there was a rabbit named Benny. Benny was very funny and loved to joke around with his friends. One day, Benny saw his friend, a turtle named Timmy, with a patch on his shell. Benny asked, "What happened to you, Timmy?"
Timmy replied, "I got into a fight with a rock and it broke my shell. But don't worry, I'm okay now."
Benny thought it was funny that Timmy got into a fight with a rock and joked, "Well, you better watch out for those rocks! They might be deaf and not hear you coming!" 
Timmy didn't think it was funny and said, "That's not nice, Benny. It's not funny to make fun of someone who is hurt." 
Benny felt bad and apologized to Timmy. He learned that it's not okay to joke about someone's injury or disability. From that day on, Benny made sure to be kind and not make fun of anyone.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy had a favorite toy, a big red ball. He liked to play with it every day. But one Tuesday, Timmy's ball was gone. He looked everywhere for it but couldn't find it. Timmy was sad because he loved that ball so much. 
The next day, Timmy's mom found the ball in the backyard. It was spoiled because it had been left outside in the rain. Timmy was happy to have his ball back, but he was sad that it was ruined. His mom told him they could get a new ball, but Timmy said he didn't want a new one. He loved his old ball even though it was spoiled. 
From that day on, Timmy took better care of his toys and didn't leave them outside in the rain. He learned that it's important to do things to take care of the things we love. And even though his ball was spoiled, he still loved it just the same.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys, but her room was very messy. Her mom said, "Lily, please clean up your room. It's so messy!"
Lily replied, "Okay, Mommy. I will clean up my room." She started to put her toys away in her cupboard. While she was cleaning, her friend Emma came over to play.
Emma said, "Wow, Lily! Your room looks so clean now."
Lily smiled and said, "Thank you, Emma. I went to my cupboard to put my toys away." They continued to play together in Lily's now clean room.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. She loved to play with her toy animals. One day, she found a small, dead bug outside. Sue felt sad for the bug.
Sue had an idea. She found a little box, like a cell. She put the dead bug in the cell. She thought it would be a nice home for the bug. Sue put the cell next to her toy animals. Now, the bug was part of her playtime.
Every day, Sue played with her toy animals and the dead bug in the cell. She was happy that she could give the bug a new home. Sue learned that even small things can be important and special.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved watching television with her mommy. One day, while they were watching their favorite show, the television suddenly split in two! 
"Oh no!" cried Lily's mommy. "What are we going to do now?"
Lily thought for a moment and then had a thoughtful idea. "Let's go to the store and buy a new television!" she said. 
So, they went to the store and found a new television. They were very happy and excited to go home and watch their favorite show again. And from that day on, they always made sure to be careful with their television so it wouldn't split again.

"How come Daisy's file isn't covered?" asked Peter.
"She's feeling dizzy today," replied Mom.
"But why isn't it covered?" asked Peter.
"She needs a break," said Mom, "so she decided to leave it uncovered."
Peter nodded his head and thought for a moment. 
"That's OK," he said finally. "I can cover her file for her."
So Peter grabbed Daisy's file and headed for his bedroom. He carefully placed the file on his desk, grabbed the blanket from his bed, and covered the file.
"There," he said, feeling proud of himself. "Daisy's file is covered!"

Every night, the sun would lead the sky to a beautiful sunset. It was so pretty that the whole world would stop and admire the sunset.
One night, Ben and his mommy were out looking at the sunset together. Mommy said, “Look Ben, isn’t this an intelligent sunset?”
Ben didn’t understand. He asked his mommy, “What’s intelligent mean?” 
Mommy smiled. She said, “It means something so beautiful it’s almost like it knows what it’s doing.”
Ben said, “Oh! Like a sunset!”
Mommy laughed and hugged Ben tight. They watched the intelligent sunset together until the top of the sky turned dark and it was time to go home.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat pizza with pepper on it. One day, her mom made pizza for dinner, but she accidentally put too much pepper on it. When Lily took a bite, her mouth started to burn and she felt scared. 
Lily's mom noticed that she was crying and asked what was wrong. Lily told her that the pizza was too spicy and scary. Her mom quickly removed the pepper from the pizza and gave her a glass of milk to cool down her mouth. 
Lily felt much better and was happy that her mom helped her. From then on, Lily's mom always made sure to put just the right amount of pepper on her pizza so it wouldn't be too scary or spicy for her. The end.

There was a dark forest. 
In the forest, there lived a small bunny.
The bunny had an important task to do. 
It had to print something for all the animals. 
So, the bunny decided to search for the best place to print. 
He hopped and hopped, until he found a dark spot in the forest. 
The bunny felt the dark spot was just right and he eagerly began to print his document. 
As the bunny printed and printed, the animals gathered nearby and watched in amazement. 
They had never seen anything like it before!
The bunny was so proud that he had found the perfect spot to print. 
He had saved the day and the forest animals were overjoyed! 
From that day onward, the bunny was known as the Printing King of the forest.

Once upon a time, there was a dull, gray cat named Kitty. Kitty had a big toe that hurt a lot. One day, Kitty met a nice dog named Doggy. Doggy wanted to help Kitty feel better.
Doggy said, "I can supply a big, soft bed for your toe to rest on." Kitty was happy and said, "Thank you, Doggy!" So, Kitty put her toe on the soft bed and tried to rest.
But then, a mean bird came and took the soft bed away. Kitty's toe still hurt, and she was sad. Doggy tried to get the bed back, but the bird flew away too fast. Kitty and Doggy were both sad that they could not make the toe feel better. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little star who lived high up in the sky. The star was very tight with all its friends. They loved to play together, and they always had fun.
One day, the little star's friends decided to plan a big surprise for the star. They wanted to make the star feel very happy. So, they all worked together and made a beautiful, shiny gift.
The next day, the friends went to the little star and said, "We have a surprise for you!" The little star was so excited and couldn't wait to see the gift. When the star opened the gift, it was a big, bright, and shiny ball.
The little star was so happy and said, "Thank you, friends! I love my surprise!" They all laughed and played with the shiny ball together, and the little star felt so loved by its tight friends.

One day, a pale butterfly was flying in the garden. It saw a little girl named Mia sitting on the grass. Mia was feeling sad. The butterfly wanted to help Mia feel better.
The butterfly flew close to Mia and said, "Why are you sad? Let me help you." Mia looked at the butterfly and said, "I am sad because I can't sing. My friends can sing, but I can't." The butterfly thought for a moment and said, "I can help you learn to sing. Just follow me."
The butterfly led Mia to a hidden spot in the garden, where there was a magic flower. Mia didn't know that the flower was magic. The butterfly told Mia to sing a song near the flower. When Mia started to sing, the flower glowed, and her voice became beautiful. Mia was so happy and thanked the butterfly. They both sang together and played in the garden all day.

One day, Sarah opened her closet and was met with a smelly surprise. In the closet was a large wrap. She looked over at her friend Joe and shrugged.
"What's that?" she asked.
Joe leaned in and sniffed it. "It sure does smell," he said.
Sarah poked the wrap and it wriggled. "It's alive!"
Joe's eyes grew big and he let out a big "whoa." They both took a step back.
"Do you think we should open it?" Sarah asked.
Joe thought for a moment and then shrugged. He stepped forward and carefully opened the wrap. Inside, to their surprise, was a tiny puppy.
The puppy jumped out and excitedly licked their faces. Sarah and Joe broke into laughter and hugged the puppy tight. They named it "Smelly" due to its curious aroma.
From that day on, Sarah, Joe, and Smelly were inseparable.

Once upon a time, there was a farmer named Jack. He had a big farm with many animals. One day, Jack was very grateful because his cow gave him lots of milk. He said, "Thank you, cow! You are the best cow ever!"
Later that day, Jack went to the market to display his vegetables. A little boy came up to him and said, "Wow, you have so many vegetables! Can I have some?" Jack replied, "Of course, little one! Take as much as you want." The little boy was very happy and said, "Thank you, farmer! You are so kind." 
Jack smiled and said, "No problem, I love sharing my vegetables with others. It makes me happy." The little boy then ran off with a big smile on his face, holding his vegetables tightly. Jack felt happy too, knowing that he made someone else happy.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She liked to go play outside. She always liked to play by the pole. The pole was tall and strong. 
One day, the little girl was playing by the pole and her ball got stuck near the top. She wanted to get it back, but she was too small. She was very sad. 
Then, a big man came along. He smiled at her and said he could help her get her ball back. She was so happy! He used a big stick and pulled the ball down from the pole, saving it. 
But then, the stick got stuck on the pole too! The big man tried and tried to get it down, but it was so high. He said he was sorry. 
But just then, he had an idea! He asked the little girl to get some rope from her house. She was happy to help and quickly ran home to get it. 
When she came back, the man used the rope to tie the stick to the pole. He said a few magic words, and then pulled on the rope as hard as he could. To the little girl's surprise, the stick came tearing off the pole! 
The little girl was so relieved. Now, she had her ball back, and it was safe! She thanked the big man, gave him a big hug, and ran off happily to play with her ball.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big white paper and some colorful pens. She wanted to draw a pretty picture for her mommy. She started to draw, but suddenly her blue pen broke and the ink spilled all over the paper. 
Lily's friend, Timmy, came to play with her. "What happened, Lily?" Timmy asked. "My pen broke and now my picture is ruined," Lily said with a sad face. "Don't worry, I can help you," Timmy said. He took another paper and told Lily to draw on it. 
Lily drew a beautiful picture on the new paper. "Look, it's so pretty," she said, showing it to Timmy. "Now let's separate the empty paper from the messy one," Timmy said. They put the messy paper in the bin and kept the pretty one to show to Lily's mommy. Lily was happy again and thanked Timmy for his help.

Lily and Ben are friends. They like to walk in the park and look at the sky. The sky is blue and has white clouds. Sometimes they see birds and planes.
One day, they walk to the pond. They see ducks and fish. Lily wants to feed the ducks. She has some bread in her bag. She takes out a piece and throws it to the ducks.
But Ben is hungry. He sees the bread and wants some too. He grabs the bag from Lily and opens it. He takes out another piece and eats it.
Lily is angry. She says, "Ben, that is not nice! That is my bread! Give it back!"
Ben says, "No, I want it! It is yummy!"
They start to pull the bag. The bag rips. The bread falls out. The ducks come and eat the bread.
Lily and Ben are sad. They have no bread left. They look at the ducks. The ducks are happy.
Lily says, "Ben, I am sorry. I should have shared my bread with you."
Ben says, "Lily, I am sorry too. I should not have taken your bread. You are my friend."
They hug. They say, "We are sorry, ducks. We hope you enjoy the bread."
The ducks quack. They say, "Thank you, Lily and Ben. You are kind."
Lily and Ben smile. They walk back to the park. They look at the sky. The sky is still blue and has white clouds. They are happy.

Lily likes to skip. She skips to the park with her mom. She sees a dog. The dog is big and brown. The dog is smelly.
"Hi, dog!" Lily says. She wants to pet the dog. She skips to the dog.
But the dog does not like to skip. The dog barks at Lily. The dog shows his teeth. The dog is angry.
"Stop, Lily!" Mom says. "The dog is not friendly. The dog is scared of you. Come back to me."
Lily is sad. She likes dogs. She does not want to scare the dog. She goes back to Mom.
"Sorry, dog," Lily says. "I just wanted to say hi. You are a good dog. But you need a bath. You are very smelly."
The dog stops barking. The dog wags his tail. The dog is sorry too. He likes Lily. He just does not like to skip.
Mom and Lily leave the park. They skip home. They are happy. They will come back another day. Maybe the dog will be clean and friendly then.
